from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u033/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
task_file = program_dir / 'task-d08396ac.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_d08396ac', task_file)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Build the received demo pair from its listed non-background cells.
demo_positions = [[], [], [4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18], [3,5,7], [], [5,7], [3,5,7,9,11,13], [5,7,9], [9,11,13,15], [7,9,11,13,15,17], [5,7,9,11], [4,6], [5,7,9], [0,2,4,6,8], [], [], [8,10,12,14], []]
demo_in = [[9]*21 for _ in range(18)]
for r, cols in enumerate(demo_positions):
    for c in cols: demo_in[r][c] = 3
demo_out_positions = [sorted(set(cols) | {x+1 for x,y in zip(cols, cols[1:]) if y-x==2}) for cols in demo_positions]
demo_out = [[9]*21 for _ in range(18)]
for r, cols in enumerate(demo_out_positions):
    for c in cols: demo_out[r][c] = 3
    for c in set(cols)-set(demo_positions[r]): demo_out[r][c] = 2
assert mod.transform(demo_in) == demo_out
